name: Taurerwirt
beschreibung: The Taurerwirt is situated in the heart of Kals am Großglockner, an alpine village resting at the foot of Austria's highest peak. The establishment pairs traditional Tyrolean hospitality with a warm and inviting ambiance. Guests can savour delectable regional cuisine and gain authentic insights into life within the Hohe Tauern National Park. The surrounding mountain landscape beckons outdoor enthusiasts with breathtaking hiking and alpine activities.
